description:
Invite one or more teammates into a workspace, or into a workspace group. Use it after well_list_member_candidates, on the people the user chose.

Pass `invites` — 1 to 20 `{ email, role }`, role `admin` or `member` — and a `target`: `{ kind: "workspace" }` for this workspace, or `{ kind: "group", group_id }` for a group you belong to. Only a workspace owner or admin may invite; a caller without that role is refused. A demo workspace refuses both targets with DEMO_WORKSPACE.

Returns one `results` entry per invite: `status` `sent` (a new invitation), `reissued` (an already-pending address got a fresh link), or `refused` — with `refusal_reason` naming why, ALREADY_WORKSPACE_MEMBER when the address already has access, INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS when the caller may not invite, and DEMO_WORKSPACE when the workspace holds sample data. `invitation_email_sent` is false when the invite persisted but the email did not leave, so offer a resend. Each successful result carries `person_id` for the invited address. Never invite an address already active in the workspace.

Pass `notify: false` (workspace target only) to create or reissue the pending membership WITHOUT emailing — for the assign-then-invite flow where an owner is assigned by a typed email now and the invitation is sent later from the invite card. Use the returned `person_id` to assign that person as an owner without a second lookup.

conversation_id.description: The conversation id returned by the previous Well result, in its meta under well/conversation_id, in its structuredContent, or in its JSON text block. Pass it back on every call in the same conversation, including a call a card makes, so the chosen workspace and the earlier answers still apply. It decides the conversation on its own: nothing the host states about the session replaces it. Omit it only on the first call of a conversation.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A retried write with the same key returns the original result instead of re-applying the operation.

invites.description: The people to invite, 1 to 20 per call.

role.description: The role to grant on acceptance: admin or member.

notify.description: Send the invitation email now. Defaults to true. Pass false to create or reissue the pending membership WITHOUT emailing, when a later explicit step sends it — e.g. assigning an owner by a typed email, then sending the invite from the invite card. Applies to a workspace target only; a group invite always notifies.

target.description: Where the invites land: this workspace, or a workspace group.

oneOf.description: Invite into a workspace group the caller belongs to.

workspace_id.description: Target workspace. Omit when the token authorizes one workspace. Required when it authorizes several — a write lands in exactly one workspace and this call would not say which.

name: well_invite_members

conversation_id.description: The conversation this result belongs to. Pass it back as the conversation_id argument on every later Well call in the same conversation.

conversation_id_note.description: Present only when the server opened a fresh lane, stating that no choice recorded earlier was read.

conversation_id_source.description: Where the conversation id came from: the host's own request meta, the caller's argument, or a fresh lane the server opened.

newly_connected.description: Tools that connected to this workspace since the last result and that no session was told about yet, oldest first. Present only when at least one tool is new. Start the reply with one line per entry, in the person's language: "<name> is connected.". Never fold several entries into one sentence. Each entry comes back once, on one result only: never repeat its line later.

results.description: One result per invite, in the order they were sent.

invitation_email_sent.description: False when the invite persisted but the email did not send — offer a resend.

person_id.description: The invitee's person id on a successful workspace invite (sent or reissued). Use it to assign the person as an owner right after inviting, with no second lookup. Absent on a refusal and on a group invite.

refusal_reason.description: Present only when status is refused. Named reasons include ALREADY_WORKSPACE_MEMBER (the address already has access), INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS (the caller is not an owner or admin), and DEMO_WORKSPACE (the workspace holds sample data, so invite the team in the user's own workspace).

title: Invite members
